The pre-registered confirmatory test on held-out data (analysis_id ecology-null-5023:c1:88cb19e95c77) returned estimate -0.132, SE 0.135, p=0.330, which is not significant at alpha=0.05. The effect did not replicate, so no direct effect is confirmed.

# robust SE
mr = sm.OLS(d['species_richness'], X).fit(cov_type='HC3')
print("HC3:", mr.pvalues[['leaf_litter','grazing_index']])

# residualize within region

    ry = sm.OLS(d['species_richness'], Xr).fit().resid
    re = sm.OLS(d[e], Xr).fit().resid
